name: lambda_in_class.k
model:
class MathFunctions {
  double:Array[Int, Int]
  square:Array[Int, Int]

  req double[0] = 0

  req double[1] = 2

  req double[5] = 10

  req double[10] = 20

  req square[0] = 0

  req square[1] = 1

  req square[2] = 4

  req square[3] = 9

  req square[10] = 100
}

m:MathFunctions

x:Int

req x > 0

req x < 5

req m.double[x] = 2 * x

req m.square[x] = x * x
smt:

; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===

(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (m Ref)(x Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((MathFunctions (mk-MathFunctions (double (Array Int Int))(square (Array Int Int))))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-MathFunctions (sel-MathFunctions MathFunctions))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-MathFunctions ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-MathFunctions (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-MathFunctions ((this Ref)) MathFunctions
  (sel-MathFunctions (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-MathFunctions ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-MathFunctions this)
)

;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.m: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!m ((this Ref)) Ref

)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.x: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!x ((this Ref)) Int

; ------------------------------------

)

(define-fun MathFunctions!double ((this Ref)) (Array Int Int)
  (double (deref-MathFunctions this))
)

; --- getters for MathFunctions.square: ---

(define-fun MathFunctions.square ((this Ref)) (Array Int Int)
  (square (deref-MathFunctions this))
)

(define-fun MathFunctions!square ((this Ref)) (Array Int Int)
  (square (deref-MathFunctions this))

    heap
    (store(store
